blockingFindings.title: Prompt movement instruction is not tested as a single contract
blockingFindings.issue: The tests assert that words like "prompt guidance", "move", "shared regression tests", and "placement-contract assertions" appear somewhere in the skill file, but they do not require those terms to appear in the same instruction or procedural context. The test could pass if the words are scattered across unrelated sections without requiring the procedure to check related shared regression tests when prompt guidance moves.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Assert a cohesive instruction fragment or paragraph that ties prompt guidance movement to checking related shared regression tests for placement-contract assertions.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R1 and R4 require a specific procedural instruction contract, and the current tests can pass without exercising that production behavior.

blockingFindings.title: General applicability is not validated
blockingFindings.issue: The R3 test only checks for the presence of "flow skill" and "flow prompt" and the absence of the exact phrase "workflow board guidance only". Procedure text limited to workflow board guidance using different wording would still pass.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add an assertion that the movement rule applies to prompt guidance generally, or reject workflow-board-specific qualifiers in the relevant instruction text.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R3 requires the rule not be limited to workflow board guidance, but the current test does not actually guard that requirement.

requirements.desc: When SDD flow procedure text describes implementation work involving prompt guidance moved between flow skill or flow prompt files, it shall require checking related shared regression tests for placement-contract assertions.
The procedure text shall explicitly require both old-placement removal assertions and new-placement presence assertions for moved prompt guidance.
The procedure text shall apply to prompt guidance movement in general and shall not limit the rule to workflow board guidance only.
Spec-local tests shall verify the SDD flow skill source contains the prompt-guidance movement regression-test instruction and the two placement assertion requirements.
If the implementation changes `src/skills/`, generated agent skills shall be updated by running `sdd-forge upgrade`.
